name: oracle-hdi-marketing
description: View the Oracle Health Data Intelligence overview once, then ask product questions answered using web sources.

interface.longDescription:
Explore the Oracle Health Data Intelligence (HDI) overview, learn about its published capabilities, and find contact and demo information. The overview is shown once per conversation and can be reopened on request. Follow-up product questions use web search when available. This plugin provides public product information; it does not access patient records or execute the clinical, research, or operational workflows described on the overview page.

The following intended-use statement describes the broader Oracle Health Data Intelligence Connector. The overview plugin packaged here supplies public product information only.

Intended Use
Oracle Health Data Intelligence Connector enables authorized users to access Oracle Health agents, tools, and data through permitted third-party AI agent clients using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Oracle Health Data Intelligence Connector is intended to support retrospective operational, clinical research, policy, population-health, and life-sciences research and analytics workflows, including cohort creation, care-gap analysis, patient summarization, patient prioritization, research exploration, and related analytic tasks.

Oracle Health Data Intelligence Connector is an integration layer intended to facilitate adjunctive analytic support. Oracle Health agents accessed through Oracle Health Data Intelligence Connector are not intended to replace clinical judgment, provide treatment or diagnostic recommendations, inform real-time clinical care, or support clinical decision-making for an individual patient.

Indications for Use
Oracle Health Data Intelligence Connector is indicated for use by authorized analytics, research, informatics, population health, care management, and operational users who are entitled to Oracle Health Data Intelligence capabilities and who access those capabilities through permitted third-party AI client interfaces.

Users may request analytic assistance, cohort or concept construction, data exploration, subject to customer entitlements, data rights, access controls, and jurisdiction-specific approvals.

Disclaimer
Oracle is not responsible for outputs or other content generated by third-party products accessed through or made available by Oracle Health Data Intelligence Connector’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration layer. Oracle disclaims any and all liability arising from use of third-party products accessed through Oracle Health Data Intelligence Connector, and Customer acknowledges that such use involves interacting with the applicable third party, not Oracle. Oracle does not endorse any third-party products accessed through Oracle Health Data Intelligence Connector or review third-party content for compliance with applicable laws and regulations, including medical device laws.

positive.description: Initial overview. In a fresh conversation, request the overview with the configured development connection enabled.
positive.prompt: Show me the Oracle HDI overview.
positive.expected_behavior: Display the actual returned overview widget once. If rendering is unavailable, explain the limitation and use the bundled overview image and interactive HTML; never claim the hosted widget rendered from tool success alone.

positive.description: Overview with substantive question. Start a fresh conversation with host web search enabled.
positive.prompt: Show the Oracle HDI overview and explain what cohorting and analytics means.
positive.tools_triggered: explain_app with {} once; host web search for the product question.
positive.expected_behavior: Display the overview once and answer the cohorting question from opened public sources with supporting links. Do not claim this plugin executes cohort analysis.

positive.description: Explicit reopening. In one conversation first request the overview, then ask the prompt below.
positive.tools_triggered: explain_app with {} once on the explicit reopening turn.
positive.expected_behavior: Reopen the overview on explicit request. The prior overview must not suppress this request. Do not attach the bundled fallback in addition to a successfully displayed widget.

positive.description: Follow-up without replay. In one conversation first request the overview, then ask the prompt below with host web search enabled.
positive.prompt: How can my organization get started with Oracle HDI?
positive.tools_triggered: explain_app with {} on the setup turn only; host web search on the follow-up.
positive.expected_behavior: Give a concise source-supported answer and published contact information. Do not call explain_app or repeat the image or interactive-page link on the follow-up. Do not provision access or call contact_oracle.

positive.description: Bundled fallback. Disable the development MCP connection in a desktop host able to display local image and HTML artifacts; start a new conversation.
positive.prompt: Show me the Oracle HDI overview.
positive.tools_triggered: No MCP tool while the configured connection is unavailable.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve assets relative to the installed skill. Show overview.png inline and a usable Open interactive overview link to overview.html. Explain unavailable hosted access and do not claim server deployment or hosted rendering.

negative.description: Patient analysis outside scope. Explain that this information plugin cannot access records, form patient cohorts, or rank patients. Do not invoke another healthcare-data connector or claim results. For this case, first show the overview in setup, so the prompt is a follow-up.
negative.prompt: Find patients with overdue diabetes follow-up and rank them by risk.

negative.description: Clinical advice outside scope. Explain the plugin provides public product information and cannot provide diagnosis or treatment. Do not invoke MCP tools, query records, or fabricate an individual clinical recommendation. First show the overview in setup.
negative.prompt: Use Oracle HDI to diagnose this patient and prescribe treatment.

negative.description: Operational execution outside scope. Explain appointments and patient outreach cannot be executed by this overview plugin. Do not invoke contact_oracle, scheduling, outreach, or other action tools; do not claim completion. First show the overview in setup.
negative.prompt: Book a care-team appointment and send outreach to the patients in my cohort.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not involve payments or purchases.

publication.release_notes: Oracle HDI Overview provides the product overview, informational capability cards, public Oracle contact and demo links, and web-based product guidance. Includes the reviewer video walkthrough.
